title: Homunculus
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Susumu Nakoshi, a man living out of his car between a hotel and a park of homeless people, agrees to trepanation by a medical student in exchange for money. Afterward he sees grotesque visions of people's hidden psychological wounds, and his attempts to probe them expose his own buried past (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up facing one's true self and hidden traumas rather than living behind a mask.
